[SWS_DM_01975] Indicator reporting kOff
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04204
⌈
If all indicators of an event assigned to a DTC are in state kOff, the
Diagnostic
Server instance
shall return kOff as return value of
ara::diag::Indicator::
GetIndicatorState
⌋
The DM does not evaluate the
DiagnosticConnectedIndicator.behavior
.
Each DiagnosticIndicator has the states Off and OnDemand as defined in
